verdict.rationale: Render has a dedicated first-party webhooks doc page saying workspaces can configure webhooks to notify other systems when service events occur, such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down. That covers the core of subscribing to events. The evidence is a single doc snippet without detail or outside confirmation. Missing for 10: full event catalog, payload signing and retry details, programmatic webhook management via API/CLI/MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
